description_en: A verification scheme identifies authentication scenarios for an application (App). Each scheme typically corresponds to an App name, App package name, and package signature. The required parameters vary depending on the access terminal. You can call this API to create a verification scheme
description_zh: 认证方案用于标识App下的认证场景，一般一个认证方案对应一个App名称、App包名、包签名等信息（接入端不同对应所需参数也不同），调用本接口创建认证方案
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi create-verify-scheme --scheme-name '一键登录认证方案' --app-name '阿里云通信' --os-type iOS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVerifyScheme

parameters.help_en:
Operating system type of the client. Valid values:

iOS

Android

Harmony

Web
parameters.help_zh:
终端操作系统类型，取值：

iOS
Android
Harmony
Web
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: Package name. Required when OsType is Android. Must contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores, or periods. Length: 1 to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 包名，osType为Android时必填。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: pack_name

parameters.help_en: Package signature. Required when OsType is Android. Must contain only digits and letters. Length: 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 包签名，osType为Android时必填。由数字和字母组成，长度为32个字符
parameters.name: pack_sign

parameters.help_en: Bundle ID. Required when OsType is iOS. Must contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores, or periods. Length: 1 to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: BundleID，osType为iOS时必填。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: bundle_id

parameters.help_en: Source URL of the H5 scheme page. We recommend specifying the domain level
parameters.help_zh: H5方案页面源地址（建议填写域名级别）
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: Page URL used by the H5 scheme
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_zh: 中国移动通道Code，默认可不填
parameters.name: cm_api_code

parameters.help_zh: 中国联通通道Code，默认可不填
parameters.name: cu_api_code

parameters.help_zh: 中国电信通道Code，默认可不填
parameters.name: ct_api_code

parameters.help_en: Email address to receive the key. Optional
parameters.help_zh: 密钥获取接收邮箱地址，默认可不填
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
Authentication type. Optional. Select multiple values only if number authentication is supported. Separate multiple values with commas.

1: Number authentication.

2: Text message authentication
parameters.help_zh:
认证类型，默认不填，只有支持号码认证时可多选，以英文逗号间隔。

1：号码认证。

2：短信认证
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en: Bound text message signature. Valid only if AuthType includes 2 (text message authentication). The signature must be approved and created under the number authentication product
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的短信签名，只有AuthType包含2（短信认证）时才有效，且签名必须是号码认证产品下创建的已经审核通过的
parameters.name: sms_sign_name

parameters.help_en: Package name. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Must contain only digits, letters, underscores, or periods. Must start with a letter. Length: 7 to 127 characters
parameters.help_zh: 包名，osType为`Harmony`时必填。由数字、字母、下划线或点组成.必须以字母开头，长度限制为7~127个字符
parameters.name: hm_package_name

parameters.help_en: Package signature. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Must contain only digits and letters. Length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 包签名，osType为`Harmony`时必填。由数字和字母组成，长度为64个字符
parameters.name: hm_sign_name

parameters.help_en: App ID. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Length: 19 digits
parameters.help_zh: AppId，osType为`Harmony`时必填。长度为19位纯数字
parameters.name: hm_app_identifier
